sources.note: Rotary International peace fellowships page with the application timeline

awarding_body.detail: The source URL resolves to Rotary Internationals own site (rotary.org), The Rotary Foundation programme. Official.
awarding_body.quote: Each year, The Rotary Foundation awards up to 50 fellowships for masters degrees and up to 120 for certificate studies at premier universities.

deadline.detail: The record publishes "Submit your application between February and 15 May" with deadline_date 2027-05-15. The page states the 2027-28 application is now closed and that the 2028-29 application "will be available online in February 2027" — it confirms the February application window pattern but publishes no 15 May deadline. The exact day cannot be confirmed from this page.
deadline.quote: The 2027-28 Rotary Peace Fellowship application is now closed. The 2028-29 Rotary Peace Fellowship application will be available online in February 2027.

eligibility.detail: The page describes leaders with work experience in peace and development committed to community and international service; the master programmes run 15-24 months with a field study, the certificate is a one-year blended programme for working professionals. The record matches; the detailed exclusions (no doctoral study, Rotary relationship restrictions) live on the eligibility pages.
eligibility.quote: The Rotary Peace Fellowship is designed for leaders with work experience in peace and development. Our fellows are committed to community and international service and the pursuit of peace.

funding.detail: The fellowships cover tuition and fees, room and board, round-trip transportation, and internship and field-study expenses, and Rotary awards up to 170 funded fellowships a year. Fully Funded is accurate.
funding.quote: The fellowships cover tuition and fees, room and board, round-trip transportation, and internship and field-study expenses.

degree_levels.detail: Master's degrees (up to 50 fellowships) and the professional development certificate (up to 120) match the record.
degree_levels.quote: up to 50 fellowships for masters degrees and up to 120 for certificate studies

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Application opens February 2027 for the 2028-29 fellowship; the 2027-28 application is closed
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Spot-checked live on rotary.org on 2026-10-12. Programme, funding and levels confirmed. The 15 May deadline is not published on this page: the page only states the 2027-28 round closed and that the 2028-29 application opens in February 2027. The 15 May date is stable across past Rotary cycles but is not confirmable from the page, so it stays as a reviewer decision.

notes_for_reviewer: This is a spot check of a record already marked active. Everything is confirmed except the deadline day, which the official page does not publish. The record stays active on the strength of the rest; the 15 May date should be re-read from the application announcement when it appears in February 2027.
